title: De-duplicate the TrackDetailScreen dual-progress and bulk-prior-tile assertions shared by track_detail_screen_test.dart and edit_track_and_detail_l1_test.dart
why: Two independent files pin the identical TrackDetailScreen behaviors — the zero-valued dual-progress labels and the bulk-prior tile's outlined/tileColor styling — with near line-for-line matching assertions. This is dead weight, not extra protection: any copy or styling change must be updated in two places using two different fixture-building helpers (_overridesFor vs _buildDetailApp), and it contributes ~200 of edit_track_and_detail_l1_test.dart's 1733 lines to content that already has a dedicated, purpose-built home. It also obscures which file is the canonical owner of TrackDetailScreen coverage going forward.
recommendation: Keep track_detail_screen_test.dart (the Task #16-scoped file) as the sole owner of dual-progress/bulk-prior-tile assertions; delete the duplicate groups from edit_track_and_detail_l1_test.dart, retaining only scenarios unique to the combined edit+detail flow (B-EDIT-NAME title propagation across navigation, min-1-curriculum delete gating, chazara header wiring).
acceptance_criteria: Only one test file asserts 'Track progress: 0%'/'Lifetime: 0%' and the bulk-prior tile's shape/tileColor properties
make test-story/epic runs for tracks/setup still pass after consolidation with no coverage loss for the removed duplicate assertions
